newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares up at noon on support buying.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares up at noon on support buying.

text.p: Shanghai B shares were up at midday on Tuesday with institutional buying supporting shares with heavy index wighting, including Shanghai Dazhong Taxi Co Ltd and Pudong real estate shares, brokers said.
The B index rose 0.857 points or 0.95 percent to 90.902 points on volume of 11.084 million shares worth $9.710 million.
Brokers said institutional support stabilized the B share market despite falls in A shares, but market sentiment was cautious after Monday's surges.
"Institutions pushed some share prices to very high levels, but most shares remained unmoved," one broker said. "So further solid gains will depend on these unmoved shares."
"Technically the market will rise further in the short term," another broker said. "But the performance of A shares and the government's attitude will affect the market."
Of 43 B shares, 34 traded, with 14 up, seven flat and 13 down.
Shanghai Dazhong Taxi was the star on speculative buying, jumping $0.132 or 7.14 percent to $1.980 on volume of 993,000 shares.

Pudong real estate counter Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development was the most actively traded on domestic investor buying, rising $0.024 or 3.11 percent to $0.794 on volume of 1.4 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index tumbled on both profit-taking and selling to unwind positions, which made most investors more cautious, brokers said.
The index fell 15.501 points or 1.11 percent to 1,379.838 points on volume of 342.4 million shares worth 5.3 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index dipped 27.648 points or 0.68 percent to 4,052.478 points.
Chengdu Measuring & Cutting Tools Co was the biggest loser, slipping 0.42 yuan or 7.27 percent to 5.35 yuan on volume of 619,700 shares.
